quotes.text: The recorded accessibility-review prompt used an outdated 14-check HCM framing; the local checklist then had 12 checks. Count the current checklist before reporting coverage because its contents can change. The count of 12 is historical, not a current requirement.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.
